question: Will the USDA reopen the Columbus, New Mexico port of entry to Mexican cattle imports before October 31, 2026?

calls.reasoning: USDA announced on Oct 19, 2026 that Columbus, NM reopens to Mexican cattle imports on Oct 26, 2026, before the Oct 29-30 resolution window. Base rate for announced APHIS port reopening dates in this sequence holding is high (Douglas Aug 24 and Santa Teresa Sep 24 both reopened as announced). Main risk: a pause before Oct 26 due to new NWS cases in Grant County NM (infested zone reaching Luna County), though the announcement came after those cases; minor risk the APHIS page isn't updated (fallback to credible sources). No human market found.
calls.dossier:
- Meatingplace (2026-10-19): USDA said Monday Oct 19 that Columbus, NM will be the third crossing reopened for Mexican cattle imports as of Oct 26, 2026. Sec. Rollins visiting Columbus Stockyards Oct 20 with Under Sec. Hoskins and RADM Schmoyer (NWS Directorate).
- Same source: reopening proceeds despite two new NWS cases (calf, horse) confirmed the prior week in Grant County NM (3 total in county); two infested zones within 12-mile radius, one extending into Luna County (where Columbus is); surveillance zone covers most of SW NM toward Columbus.
- Ag Bull Trading (Oct 2026): Chihuahua Cattlemen's Union expects Columbus to reopen Oct 26 at 750 head/day.
- AgDaily headline (Oct 2026): 'N.M. screwworm cases threaten cattle border reopening' (shows that risk to the reopening was being discussed).
- USDA press release 2026-07-24: phased reopening contingent on Mexico Joint Action Plan; timelines flexible and may be paused if NWS risk rises in Sonora/Chihuahua.
- Precedent: Douglas AZ reopened Aug 24 as announced; Santa Teresa NM reopened Sep 24 as announced (imports began Sep 28).
- APHIS current-status page fetch (Oct 20) returned an older cached version with no Columbus date; could not confirm the page itself lists Oct 26 yet.
- AMS (Oct 19): Douglas and Santa Teresa imports are running (2,550 head on Oct 13).
- Status quo as of Oct 20: Columbus officially announced to reopen Oct 26, not yet open.
- Resolution instrument: resolves off the APHIS 'Current Status of NWS' page port section (a listed reopening date on or before Oct 30 counts), with credible-source fallback if the page is unavailable; a date after Oct 30 does not count; a reopening later paused still counts YES if the port was open during the window.
- Event window: Oct 29, 2026 -> Oct 30, 2026 23:59 ET per criteria; as of Oct 20 the window has not started (0% elapsed).
- Markets: searched Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi; none found.
- Not found: any postponement notice after Oct 19; an updated APHIS page text.
